name: Hinata Hyuga2 Onpiece theme
description: Hinata Hyuga is a character in the popular anime and manga series Naruto, created by Masashi Kishimoto. She comes from the Hyuga clan - one of the oldest and most powerful families in the Hidden Leaf Village - and has inherited the special ability Byakugan, which allows her to see through and perceive the flow of chakra.
